title: Whether Lunceford swung and Sy Oliver's band today
summary: Durham calls Lunceford a novelty band with a two-beat that suited dancers and praises Sy Oliver's small band for staying working.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, who won this battle?
Oh, --
Because Basie, today, if you talk to Basie, -- and I've often said to him, well, all right, now, what other bands really swung? And he'd always say Lunceford.
Lunceford wasn't too much of a swinging band.
It was a --
It was a novelty band.
But you had these tempos.
He had a beat like that.
Yeah.

But that beat, that's a good beat.

But that beat today, the guys play too much rhythm these days, now. You couldn't go all night like that. Sy can get away with it because he got a lot of other stuff with it.
Yeah.
He colors it, you know what I mean? And he's playing to a smoother place. He ain't playing all this old rough, heavy stuff.
But your things were mostly written sort of like Basie would, for four-four.
Yeah, I liked that.
Well, that was good for Lunceford to have as a contrast, wasn't it?
He had a style.
Yeah, yeah.
Sy would do a good job with it, but he ain't got a big enough band. He say he just can't afford (inaudible).

Well, one thing I'll say for that band Sy's got now is that at least it's regular work. I mean, there's guys up there that are now working up there about 40 weeks out of the year or 30 weeks out of the year. And I don't know, must be fairly good in that room, I should think, wouldn't it?
Yeah. But I do say this: Sy has got the biggest little band left, now. He's the only one that's got it.
Yeah.
And I think he's holding up well. In
order to stay there as long as he is and keep this thing going, he's got to have something on the ball.

Well, I'll tell you, it's just what you were saying, though, about -- you say that was a novelty band. Basie said that -- he said, oh, they get up there and get the thing going and swing all night long. Well, of course, it was a type of swing.
Yeah, yeah.
There was a difference. But, you see, I think it's one of those things that people who are dancing like. I've been up there with --
Well, they can understand that two-beat --

That's right. And, of course, Sy always has a fair amount of melody for them. Some of them are dancing to the melody as much as -- but, anyway, when you went to Basie, this wasn't such a big change to you, because you --
